capabilities: add custom URI commands to the command palette
insert file, selection, and metadata placeholders into URIs
open Obsidian URIs such as vault or note links from commands
open external URI schemes such as mailto, spotify, and calibre
extras: Links to the Obsidian URI documentation for further help; the meta placeholder only works with URL-encoding turned off.
intentEvidence: This plugin allows you to add custom URI commands to the command palette.
problem: Running URIs (Obsidian's own scheme or external ones like mailto or calibre) from the command palette, with dynamic content from the current file, is not possible with core Obsidian.

relations.evidence: Append your selection to today's daily note (requires Advanced URI plugin)
Open this plugin's settings page (requires Hotkey Helper plugin)
Parts of this code, especially the icon picker, borrow heavily from phibr0's plugins

summary: Command builder that adds custom URI commands with file placeholders to the command palette, for Obsidian URIs and other URI schemes.
